description:
Outcome: Gardeners sign in without passwords and contacts remain coordinator-only, from owner sign-in decision and brief.md Constraints
Scope: Single-use hashed expiring tokens, resend/rate limits, safe redirects, session logout, configurable mail adapter, operator coordinator bootstrap and roles; authorize every data path; unknown verified emails see restricted pending-access page and submit minimal household verification details; coordinator searches then links or creates canonical household with duplicate checks and auditable decision. Excludes: daily digest and passwords
Acceptance: Links usable once; safe expiry recovery; only approved household members access applications/own allocations/reporting; multiple accounts share household entitlement; unknown household can reach approval and apply; pending/rejected requests have correction/contact path; other contacts absent from gardener APIs and logs; direct unauthorized requests rejected
Behaviour: Non-enumerating link request response, mail-failure recovery, accessible phone pending/approved/rejected states and errors
Verification: Auth/role integration tests, token replay/expiry, new household onboarding-to-application E2E, duplicate household requests and two accounts in one household. Prerequisites: T-002. Assumptions: provider credentials established before staging; proposed verification workflow can be adjusted following T-004
title: Email-link access and household onboarding
